raw_summary: In a landmark move, Jio Platforms, supported by Mukesh Ambani, successfully secured ₹30,213 crore, marking the largest IPO in India’s history. raw_summary: After two months of silence, September marked the return of retail investors to the secondary market, as they invested ₹10,572 crore in equities. Additionally, the primary market thrived with ₹5,650 crore in shares bought by retail investors, emphasizing that upcoming market conditions will shape their future involvement.
